name: Jearl Gabriela
source:
Commanding officer of the Special Guard that fights against the Mafia group of demons.
His true form is of the Archangel Gabriel.
A worldly man who is used to guarding God, he 
serves the king on a whim.
When it comes to matters of faith he is cool, collected, fair, and upright.
But when it comes to other things he's a stubborn guy with a quick temper who will go straight to solving things with violence, he also has a bad mouth.
